note: Line coverage of the Python tree, measured by pytest-cov in CI. The critical list is the set of modules that are the sole mechanism behind a rule in CLAUDE.md; they are held to a higher floor than the rest.

critical_modules.rule: every run is audited; an uncited memo is rejected
agents run under a request budget and a kill switch
retrieved memories are untrusted and quarantined
RBAC: roles are asserted by the server, never by the caller
every number crossing the API carries the SQL that produced it
the endpoints that spend budget are rate limited
generated results are routed away from the real ones
zero paid inference: allowances are counted, not assumed
generated data cannot reach a Term 4 artefact
